_note: USD per million tokens, per model. Empty on purpose: the dashboard shows no cost until you type in the prices from your own plan or price list, and a cost it cannot price is shown as 'n/a', never as 0. Keys are the model names the dashboard shows for your runs (the Tools & usage view lists them). A key without a version, such as "Family", covers every "Family x.y". Shape of one entry: "Model name": { "input": 0.0, "output": 0.0, "cacheRead": 0.0, "cacheWrite5m": 0.0, "cacheWrite1h": 0.0 } (cacheWrite5m and cacheWrite1h are two cache-write lifetimes some vendors price apart; use the same number twice, or 0, if yours does not). Your copy lives in the data folder (arsenale paths); this file in the repo is only the template.
